name: [percept] Camera viewpoint and angle
levels: Extreme low-angle view looking sharply upward from ground level
High-angle view looking down from above the scene
True overhead bird’s-eye view with surfaces seen planimetrically
Strict side-profile view with the subject seen edge-on
Strong Dutch-angle three-quarter view with the horizon visibly tilted
Centered eye-level frontal view

name: [percept] Shot scale
levels: Extreme macro detail showing only a small surface fragment
Tight close-up filling the frame with one object or face
Medium view showing a complete object or small arrangement
Wide view showing the arrangement within a substantial environment
Distant long shot with tiny subjects surrounded by expansive space

name: [percept] Motion and temporal blur
levels: Pin-sharp freeze-frame with every edge clearly resolved
Directional motion blur on moving forms while the background remains sharp
Panning exposure with a sharp moving subject against horizontally streaked surroundings
Long-exposure trails and smeared highlights from movement through the frame
Multiple-exposure ghosting showing several displaced positions of the same forms
Radial zoom blur converging toward the image center

name: [percept] Lighting direction and hardness
levels: Flat overcast illumination with nearly shadowless, even tonal coverage
Hard overhead midday light with short, sharply defined shadows
Strong side light producing deep chiaroscuro and a narrow bright key
Low-angle warm sunset light with long shadows and golden highlights
Backlight creating a bright rim and mostly silhouetted forms
Colored theatrical light with contrasting cool and warm directional sources

name: [percept] Illumination
levels: Flat, shadowless overcast illumination with uniformly soft edges
Hard midday sunlight from the upper left with crisp cast shadows
Low side-raking sunset light producing long shadows and strong warm highlights
Single narrow spotlight in a dark setting with dramatic chiaroscuro
Bright backlight creating a glowing rim and near-black silhouettes

name: [percept] Medium and Surface
levels: Photorealistic camera photograph with optical detail, lens falloff, and natural surface texture
Polished 3D render with smooth materials, specular reflections, and ambient occlusion
Minimal black ink line drawing on clean white paper with no painted fill
Flat-color screen print with sharp registration, halftone dots, and crisp edges
Watercolor wash on visibly absorbent cold-press paper with translucent bleeding
Cracked fresco or thick impasto oil painting with raised, tactile pigment
